scope: Future JRA official predictions only after E2E formal validation; current v3.13 final_bets are immutable
goal: A user can execute at most 3 distinct JRA betting-form purchase commands. Each must be a verified complete BOX, wheel, multi, formation or single selection, with actual numbered inputs and per-ticket amount.
price_catalog: All 8 offered ticket types still considered by independently verified source quotes; never impute missing odds.
formal_stake_optimizer: Retain v3.13 WIN-stake rules until versioned enhancement tested. This shadow only compares uniformly priced 100-yen whole groups.
selection_model: Deterministic bounded search of non-overlapping whole priced mode expansions; positive model expected net profit; optimize expected net profit then joint hit probability and number of commands, with downside and hit-rate deltas disclosed.
disclosure: Never disguise 60 independently purchased lines as 3 executable commands; the three-command counterfactual may select a materially different basket. Explain EV/hit/loss differences and note model calibration is not proven.
audit_guards: All displayed expanded tickets exactly match actual selected candidate lines, with no doubles or omissions
Complete odds, 3 scenario joint probability, no postrace recompute
Total purchase units <=3 and purchase total <=6000 yen
No forced buy when no positive expected net profit candidate
Legacy SHA, STEP1, v3.13 and historic PDFs immutable
Shadow never changes final_bets or PDF canonical pointers
version_promotion: Formal activation needs separate v3.15 model, new SHA-pinned manifest, comparable live market E2E, budget/price/portfolio proof and validated PDF and public HTTP before modifying any future canonical selection.
table_layout: Only 1-3 actionable rows on first page; show type/mode, exact horses or columns/axes, points×stake and subtotal. The full scientific audit may remain in details, never pretend it is the purchase operation list.
